'''Tham''' was an individual who worked as a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] for a living along with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tham's partner|partner]]. In [[138 ABY]], it was Tham's idea for the pair to bring their recent haul to [[Ania Solo]]'s [[Ania Solo's junkyard|junkyard]]. Tham's partner asked for ten thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for their shipment but Solo stood firm in her offer of two hundred. Tham and the Human then threatened to take whatever valuables Solo had in her junkyard but were surprised from behind by [[SD]], Solo's droid. In the end, the scavengers were escorted back to their [[Tham's ship|ship]] and forced to leave their shipment behind without receiving any payment.<ref name="Legacy 1" />
